canada.title: One dead, vehicle recovered from Petitcodiac River in Moncton
canada.summary: RCMP in Moncton are investigating how an SUV ended up in the Petitcodiac River on Friday. A body was recovered shortly after the vehicle, which had veered into the river shortly before 9:30 a.m.

canada.title: 2 charged in high-profile extortion-related shootings in Surrey

canada.title: Nunavut government, union in arbitration over casual student support assistants
canada.summary: CBC has learned that the government of Nunavut and the Nunavut Employees Union are engaged in arbitration over the role of casual student support assistants this week. The union is asking for an audit of all casual SSAs employed since August 2023 and to make these casual workers permanent.

canada.title: DNA profile created for grizzly behind deadly attack in B.C.

canada.title: Man convicted in deadly 2018 Toronto van attack drops appeal
canada.summary: The man who carried out a deadly van attack in Toronto eight years ago is no longer challenging his more than two dozen convictions.

canada.summary: A dangerous offender and sentencing hearing is underway in Calgary for Duran Ross Buffalo, 41, who was convicted of aggravated sexual assault and break-and-enter to commit sexual assault by a jury last year.

canada.title: 'I felt like my body was frozen,' woman testifies at former massage therapist’s sexual assault trial
canada.summary: Kenneth Braun, 70, is charged with three counts of sexual assault and one count of sexual exploitation of a young person in a position of trust or authority. The alleged offences span 1996 to 2022.

canada.title: RCMP investigating fatal collision in Annapolis Valley

canada.title: Vitalité enlists travel nurses to fill Campbellton ER, despite province discouraging the practice

canada.title: Wind warnings issued for communities across Alberta
canada.summary: A fierce windstorm is expected to whip across a swath of Alberta communities on Friday, making for a blustery start to the weekend.

canada.title: Woman dead, man arrested after stabbing in North York: Toronto police
canada.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a woman died in a stabbing in North York Friday morning.

canada.title: Nova Scotia chooses 2026 Boston Christmas tree from East Amherst
canada.summary: A 14-metre white spruce from Nova Scotia will soon be cut and shipped to Boston as an annual Christmas gift to thank the city for its help after the Halifax Explosion.

canada.title: Disbarred former Manitoba law dean loses extradition fight in French Appeal Court
